newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile stocks end mixed in mild technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Chile stocks end mixed in mild technical rebound.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed mixed on Tuesday in a technical rally following Monday's slide with the market seen remaining in positive territory at the opening, said traders.

"I think the bolsa will open higher as prices have touched bottom," said Pedro Santa Maria, finance manager of brokerage Socimer. The selective IPSA index ended up 0.1 percent at 96.58 points. The general IGPA index shed 0.04 percent at 5,323.7 points. Turnover swelled to 14.6 billion pesos from nine billion pesos on Monday.
Traders reported a rise in demand from local investors on renewed optimism that domestic interest rates could fall towards the end of the year.

"It was a much more active session with real orders," said one dealer. "The bolsa is returning to normal little by little." Fears that the Central Bank would not ease its tight credit policy until the beginning of next year at the earliest have dampened the market's mood in recent sessions. Winners included financial group Cruz Blanca, up 3.04 percent at 152.5 pesos, telecoms company CTC, up 1.01 percent at 2,293 pesos and bottler Andina, up 0.68 percent at 2,220.
